_comment: Owner goals and constraints as data (REDESIGN Phase 4). The loop reads this file every cycle; a change of mind is an edit here, not a code change. mode: grow | bank | improve.
goal: maximum happiness: every happiness factor except Tax at 0 or better, every system good in REPORT.md, traffic flow weighted by vehicles 60% as the first mark and rising, no problem icons, net at or above the floor; energy 100% clean and renewable (new capacity verified before a coal plant is removed); zero raw sewage discharge
expansionException: below happiness 80: only the minimum a fix needs (land for a facility, a joining street, rehousing); at 80+ see expansionRule
netFloorNote: fixed by the owner; no ratchet. Spendable upkeep = net - netFloor. Waiting and earning is the answer to "cannot afford it yet"; services are never cut for money.

targets.trafficFlowNote: owner, 2026-10-12: the headline is the flow weighted by vehicles (what drivers experience); 60 is the first mark, then as high as real improvements take it. The game's unweighted figure is shown beside it for reference only. No Alley conversions and no lower speed limits to lift a number; speed bumps only where they also cut noise and accidents in residential districts. Only changes that make vehicles faster or take vehicles off the road count.

never: ground cable, pipe or ground road across water
buying a tile no road can reach
housing beside noise or in a pollution plume
priority: critical: utilities, network warnings, fires, dead or sick waiting
services by the worse of capacity, coverage and outcome
quality upgrades with little or no upkeep
spending: one-off costs only from cash above cashReserve; new upkeep only from net above the floor, by projection; below either floor only true emergencies (utility shortage, network warning, fire, water about to run out)
forbiddenNote: name parts; no placement path may build these (owner: zero raw sewage, clean power only, recycling only - no landfill, no incinerator)
sewagePolicy: export only through the outside pipe connection at (1470,7168); no raw outlet and no treatment plant may be placed
devPointsNote: owner 2026-10-11: Subway first (4 points); points are saved until it can be bought; nothing else is bought; after Subway ask the owner again

fees.note: service fees stay at the game's default unless the owner lists them here with bounds: above the default the game applies a happiness penalty (owner constraint: no negative factor except Tax). Parking fees are tuned to keep occupancy at 70-85%.

watchDistricts.name: east high-density (towers)
watchDistricts.note: owner's screenshot: garbage and hearse icons on every dense building

designStandard._note: Owner's standing instruction: decide as the city's architect; the city must look good and function well. Recorded per decision in progress.md under 'Design decisions'. Checked by mcp/src/design.ts (audit and plan check).
decideWithoutAsking: removing a few buildings for a trunk road
moving a park or a utility
rebuilding a block for a bridge or junction
askOwnerOnlyFor: spending below the cash or net floor
expansion beyond what a fix needs
demolishing something large (a whole district, a major service building)
function: clear road hierarchy with continuous trunks and few conflict points
every district has two or more ways out
services sit inside the area they serve
transit on the main desire lines with stops at real destinations
nothing cut off by a river, a railway or a highway
form: a recognisable centre, district centres, clean edges
regular, well proportioned blocks; no slivers, stub roads, dead ends or orphaned lots
roads meet at clean angles; curves smooth and deliberate
consistency: one road type along a corridor; no lane drops or sudden width changes
consistent junction types along a route
green: parks and plazas as focal points and buffers
noise barriers or planted buffers along highways and railways
density: high density near the centre, transit stops and amenities; gradual step-down
schools, clinics and shops within walking distance
no towers behind a single road
infrastructure: bridges and underpasses aligned with their corridors
ramps of 6% or less where a longer one fits, never over 8%
utilities along roads, not across blocks
unsightly or noisy things go to Northgate
designStandard.repairAsYouGo: when an area is touched: remove redundant stubs and double junctions, merge awkward node pairs, re-zone leftover strips, fill gaps with green
designStandard.conflict: function wins for safety-critical and service items; otherwise look for the design that gives both; a cleaner, lasting solution is preferred over a cheaper one

cashReserveNote: owner, 2026-10-11 21:03: keep at least 20,000,000 in cash at all times; spend only the amount above it. The net floor (netFloor, +2,300,000 a month, fixed) is unchanged.

expansionRule._note: owner, 2026-10-11: below 80 improve mode stays (no expansion except what a fix needs). At 80+ over two reviews in a row, with every non-tax factor at 0 or better, the loop switches to grow-optimal: one district per step, paid from cash above cashReserve; after each district a review must still show 80+, no negative factor and traffic no worse, else back to improve and fix first. Code: mcp/src/expansion.ts (tests mcp/test/expansion.ts).
districtStandard: best land: land value, no pollution or noise, good access
trunk road connections and two or more accesses first
transit: a tram or bus line and a stop within walking distance
services and utilities ahead of the residents (schools, clinic, fire, police, park, garbage and deathcare reach), by the always-over-needs rule
mixed uses so trips are short
a density that fits its place
